value: Natural-gas steam methane reforming, CO shift, CO2 removal and ammonia synthesis at eight Canadian facilities (the ninth, using by-product hydrogen as feedstock, is excluded); facilities 30 to 67 years old

note: "Generated Emissions" intensity, t CO2e/t NH3, sector average of 8 SMR facilities (3-year average 2018-2020, actual production). Generated = process + combustion + venting + flaring + electricity + imported steam: INCLUDES INDIRECT emissions (electricity and imported steam, 4.3% sector-wide, p.9) so it is slightly above scope 1; before CO2 recovery for urea/sale. Min 1.9 and upper 2.2 printed for all facilities but Facility 8; max 2.6 is Facility 8 (lowest production). Calculated with ECCC GHGRP methods (WCI where GHGRP silent), provincial grid factors.
